WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as station_count
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE observstation IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM telescopes
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.observstation,
    sc.station_count,
    CAST(sc.station_count AS FLOAT) / tc.total as share
  FROM station_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN total_count tc
),
avg_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares
),
excess_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    s.observstation,
    s.station_count,
    s.share,
    s.share - asc.avg_share as excess
  FROM shares s
  CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc asc
  WHERE s.share > asc.avg_share
)
SELECT
  AVG(station_count) as avg_telescope_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM excess_calc
